title: CapacityCertificationBinding.v1
description: Portable reference to a complete CapacityCertification.v1 artifact.
$comment: The gate loads repository_path, requires artifact_sha256 to match exact repository bytes, validates the loaded object against capacity_certification.v1.schema.json, recomputes certification_id from its contract-defined JCS preimage, and rejects any inline simplified object. This binding deliberately does not use schema_version CapacityCertification.v1.
